summary.text: Clarence Styvar is a Republican state representative from Wyoming who has represented House District 12 since September 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Clarence Styvar took office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on September 21, 2018, succeeding Lars Lone.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the House Revenue Committee and the Joint Revenue Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 18, 2026.
